scope: Explore how an edge-score threshold changes links while node identity and supplied spectra remain fixed. Similarity does not establish compound identity.
prediction_prompt: Predict whether lowering the edge threshold from 0.65 to 0.64 changes edges, nodes, both or neither.
expected_source_inputs: A public scene objective that asks the learner to interpret similarity evidence
Explicitly synthetic spectra with stable node identifiers
A documented similarity rule and independently checked baseline

independent_checks.description: At threshold 0.65 the checked fixture has one visible edge.
At threshold 0.64 the checked fixture has three visible edges.
The same four node identifiers remain present in both conditions.

source.title: Studium checked linked-spectrum teaching fixture
source.statement: The values are synthetic and demonstrate a documented precursor-aware modified-cosine calculation.
